title: The healthy account: the dispatcher's Monday list, every week, in one Telegram conversation
demonstrates: One messenger conversation for life: every week the dispatcher's message reopens it, the assistant drafts, the east shop's lead advisor edits and sends, and resolves. Four sessions are written: the first after go-live, found work approved with a photo and a purchase-order number, a van swapped, and this week's, which at T is confirmed and waits on the customer. It is the named open messenger chat: its last public line is the shop's and no draft sits in its box.

scenario.who_writes: The dispatcher of the account with the most visits. She has sent the Monday list by phone for years; since go-live she sends it here.
scenario.vehicles: five vans every Monday at 07:30 from the fleet of 25 (accounts.json en.A2): the units named in each session
scenario.wants: The Monday slot confirmed; found work decided the same day.
scenario.what_happens: Session 1: the first list in the messenger. Session 2: on a Monday the front struts of M-112 are found leaking; Angie sends a photo and the fleet price, the president says go ahead and gives a purchase-order number. Session 3: one van is swapped and the missed one is put on a later Monday. Session 4, the day before T: next Monday's five are confirmed and Angie asks one question that is still unanswered.

why: Tina writes like a dispatcher: unit numbers, no greeting after the first week, 'Ugh. Let me ask Hal'.
Angie's lines keep the draft's facts and add what is hers: the name twice, 'if it were my van', a choice, the summary, her name at the end.
A draft the customer overtook is 'replaced before anyone acted' (d4); a thanks that needs no answer is cleared (d6).
The healthy account beside the fading one: same channel mode, minutes instead of days.
new_facts: The Monday lists: week T-22: M-103, M-107, M-110, M-114, M-121; week T-15: five vans, M-112 among them; week T-5: M-104, M-106, M-111, M-115, M-119 (M-108 swapped out); week T-4: M-108 added; week W+1: M-102, M-109, M-113, M-116, M-122.
M-112's front struts and alignment were done on the Monday of week T-15 for 1,119.98 before tax under purchase order 4398A (the 'front struts back in the summer' of story call 25).
M-110 pulled to the right in week T-22; M-113's heater is weak in week W0; M-122's rear brakes were low at its last service.
